paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kum sawm-le-giat alal kum in Ahab tapa Jehoram Israelte tung ah Samaria ah alal pan a; kum sawm-le-nih alal hi.
heading: Moab Leh Israel Kidouna

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih a; himahleh anu leh apa bang tel in zaw thil ahih kei. Ama'n apa Baal suangphuh apaimang hi.
Himahleh, Israelte thil hihkhialsak Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhnate amah ah abelh tinten a; huai apaisan kei hi.
Moab kumpipa Mesha belam vul mi ahi a; ama'n Israel kumpipa kiang ah belamnou nuaikhat mul leh belampa nuaikhat mul siah aliau hi.
Himahleh Ahab sih nung in hichi ahong hi a, Moab kumpipa Israel kumpipa tung ah ahelta hi.
Huchih lai in Samaria a pan kumpipa Jehoram apawt a, Israel tengteng akaikhawm vek hi.

Huchi in apawt a, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat kiang ah, "Moab kumpipa ka tung ah ahel a, Moabte na hon doupih diam?" chi in mi asawl hi. Ama'n, "Hon doupih e, kei leh nang, ka mite leh na mite pum khat i hi ua, ka sakolte leh na sakolte leng pum khat ahi uh," achi hi.
Amah mah in, "Koi lampi ah ahia i kuan touh ding?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Edom gamdai lampi ah," achi hi.
Huchi in Israel kumpipa Judah kumpipa toh, Edom kumpipa toh, akuanta ua; ni sagih apaikual ua; asepaihte leh agan tonpihte dawn ding tui a-omta kei hi.
Israel kumpipa'n, "E heh he! TOUPA'N kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak dia hon pikhawm ahi peuhmah ve,” achi hi.

Himahleh Jehoshaphat in, "Hiai ah TOUPA hon dotsak ding TOUPA zawlnei kuahiam bek a-om kei maw?" achi hi. Israel kumpipa sikha khat in adawng a, "Elijah khut tui buaksekpa Shaphat tapa Elisha hiai a om ei ve," achi hi.
Jehoshaphat in, akiang ah, "Ama'n TOUPA thu anei hi," achi hi. Huchi in Israel kumpipa leh Jehoshaphat leh Edom kumpipa akiang ah ahohsukta uh.

Elisha in Israel kumpipa kiang ah, "Nang leh ke'n kizopna bang i nei a? Na pa zawlneite leh na nu zawlneite kiang ah va hoh in," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Pai lou e; kumpipa thumte Moabte khut a piak ding in TOUPA'N ahon pikhawm hi,” achi hi.
Elisha in, "Akiang a ka dinna sepaihte' TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat zahtak lou hi leng nang lam leng ka nga kei dia, muh leng ka hon mu het kei ding.
Himahleh, kaihging tumsiammi hon sam un," achi hi. Kaihging tumsiam in ahon tumleh, hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA khut atung ah ahong omta hi.
Ama'n, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai phaizang tengteng toukuak tektuk un.

TOUPA mah in hichi in achi: Huih himhim na mu kei ding ua, vuah himhim leng na mu sam kei ding uh. Himahleh hiai phaizang tui in adim vek ding hi. Huchi in nou leh na bawnghonte uh leh na gante un adawn ding uh.
Hiai TOUPA ngaih in thil neuchik lel ahi a; Moabte na khut uah ahon piak behlap ding hi.
Kulhpi nei khua tengteng leh khopi hoih tengteng na hihse ding ua, sing hoih tengteng na phuk ding ua, tuikhuk tengteng na hubing ding ua, mun hoih tata suang in na dengse vek ding uh," achi hi.
Zingsang in, thillat lat hun lai in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, Edom gam lam a pan tui ahong luang a, tui in agam ahong dimta hi.
Moab tengteng in amau sual ding in kumpipate ahong kuantou uh chih ana zak un, galdou thei chiang tengteng ana kikaikhawm ua, gamgi ah ana pangta uhi.
Huchi in zingkhang in athou ua, ni in tui tung a hon salvak a, Moabte'n azawn ua tui sisan bang a san in amu uhi.
"Sisan ei ve, kumpipate amau le amau akidou ua, amau leh amau kithat uh ahi mahmah ve. Kisa un, Moabte aw, gallak thil i va tuh ding uh,” achi uhi.
Israelte giahphual ava tun uleh, Israelte ahong thou phut ua, Moabte asual ua, huchi in ama uah ataikek uh. Moabte that kawm in agam uah adelhlutta uhi.

Khuate ahihsia ua; amun hoih tata teng uh michih in adeng ua, suang in adimgawpta hi. Tuikhuk tengteng ahubing ua, sing hoih tengteng aphuk ua; Kir-hareseth a om suangte kia akhoih kei uhi. Huai leng vaisuanglot tawi pawl in a-umkimvel ua, asual uhi.
Moab kumpipa'n akidou uh zou ding in akitheita kei, Edom kumpipa kiang a tung dia phut paisuak tum in namsau tawimi zasagih apikhia a, himahleh alohsam uhi.
Huchi in atapa upapen, asik a hong lal ding pen kulh dawn ah halmang thillat in alanta hi. Huchi in Israelte atung ah aheh mahmah ua, akisa ua, agam uah apaikik nawnta uhi.
